items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: There was a guy who used to be around here called Leon Herford, who I did not know. I did not know Leon Herford

ctx.x: He played with different people. There was a guy who used to be around here called Leon Herford, who I did not know. I did not know Leon Herford, but he was one of the older musicians around before my time.
